$comment: Lightness contract (ADR-0017). scripts/check-package.mjs enforces it in npm run check and CI. Raising a budget needs an ADR note. Sizes are bytes (1 kB = 1000 bytes, as npm reports them).

warmInit.$comment: The slowest warm run of the built CLI's init --yes, as scripts/context-budget.mjs times it on each preset and fixture after the first run (ADR-0017).

alwaysOnContext.$comment: Tokens (characters / 4) Claude Code loads in every session per preset, with SessionStart output counted at its cap (ADR-0017). scripts/context-budget.mjs and test/context-budget.test.ts enforce it; init shows it.
